project.title: ShipSafe for IBM Bob: keeps AI-written code production-ready with IBM Db2 and Granite
project.short_description: An MCP add-on for IBM Bob and other AI IDEs. The assistant checks every file before writing it (AST rules, secrets, Bandit), fixes problems with a CrewAI crew on local IBM Granite that must pass the same checks, validates SQL by PREPARE on the real Db2 database, remembers team decisions in a Db2 vector table (Haystack) and answers team-standard questions from Db2 vector search (LangChain). Every check, fix and memory is stored in IBM Db2.
project.category: AI Developer Tooling / IDE Add-on / Vector Search

members.name: Devanshu Sharma
members.role: Solo developer: MCP server, guard rules, CrewAI fix crew, Db2 schema, procedures and vector stores, VS Code/Bob extension

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition 12.1.5 (local instance created with the IBM Db2 Developer Extension for VS Code)
ibm_db2.connector: ibm_db / ibm_db_dbi, ibm_db_sa + SQLAlchemy, langchain-db2 (DB2VS), ibm-db-haystack (IBMDb2DocumentStore)
features_used: Native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) columns with VECTOR_DISTANCE (COSINE) for policies and project memory
SQL PL stored procedures with OUT parameters, a dynamic result set, SIGNAL SQLSTATE and GET DIAGNOSTICS
Server-side PREPARE with deferred prepare off to validate SQL without executing it
Catalog introspection through SQLAlchemy (ibm_db_sa) for schema-aware suggestions
Views with LAG and ROW_NUMBER window functions
Foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK and UNIQUE constraints, MERGE upserts, atomic multi-table transactions
Parameter markers everywhere, including OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
Append-only audit tables and a least-privilege role script

ai_models: IBM Granite granite-embedding:30m (384-dim embeddings, via Ollama)
